svg.title: A rolled loop and the schedule it stands for
svg.desc: Two timelines of echo_sequence on one drive line. As exported, the loop is one body, a 20 ns pulse and a 20 ns wait, with 5 trips and a period of 40 ns. The schedule it stands for repeats that body 5 times, from 0 to 200 ns, with a dotted line where each trip starts.
